description: Rename a scene object in the workspace tree. **Only folders, in-scene cameras and routes can be renamed**: they are the three kinds that store a name of their own in the save file. A character, item or light is refused — its workspace label is rebuilt from its card or from the catalogue every time the scene loads, so a rename would be lost. Not undoable, but it does not clear Studio's undo stack. Read back with the 'name' field of studio_list_objects.

id.description: id of the folder, camera or route, from studio_list_objects

name.description: the new name; any text, including non-ASCII

output.description: the object, same shape as one entry of studio_list_objects — 'name' confirms the result
